name: openssh
summary: Authenticated SSH and SFTP for the server image, cross-built from pinned OpenSSH portable 10.6p1 with the internal crypto profile and the two tracked Darwin/cross-configure patches.

license.notes: sources.lock.json records 'BSD and ISC; see upstream LICENCE and component notices'. The BSD variant is per-file in the upstream LICENCE; component notices govern until a per-file review lands.

isolation: Source must be pristine and match the locked revision. -Z -nostdlib removes default target library searches; load-command checks permit only the source-built libSystem.B.dylib and libdyld.dylib provider. Target programs are never executed on the build host. See docs/openssh-build.md.

rebuild.note: Pins are validated by scripts/build/packages.py. Guest verification (encrypted session, unauthorized-key refusal, reboot persistence) stays false in build receipts until runtime probes pass; a clean-environment rebuild comparison is remaining work.
